capabilities: Set the active tab's title to the note's first H1 heading
Update tab titles on layout, file-open, rename, and metadata events
Fall back to the filename when no H1 exists
extras: No settings; behavior is automatic once enabled. Installation is manual (copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder).
problem: Obsidian tabs show the filename, which can be terse, dated, or kebab-cased and unreadable when the note's real title lives in its H1 heading.
summary: Tab title plugin that displays a note's first H1 heading as the active tab's title instead of the filename.
